Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.
Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.
Bring the crate of candles to Father Gavin at Misty Pine Refuge.
Collect 14 pieces of firewood.
Destroy 10 minor ice elementals.
Kill Avala and retrieve its core.
Collect the rifles of fallen mountaineers.
Use the untapped dowsing widget near the pool of water by Sandsorrow Watch. Once you have collected the sample, return the tapped dowsing widget to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
Speak with Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.
Find Volcor in Darkshore and give him the Enchanted Moonstalker Cloak.
Protect Volcor until you reach the road, then speak to Terenthis in Auberdine.
Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore wants you to feed his prized puppy, Kyle the Frenzied.
objectivesText.3: Feed Kyle Tender Strider Meat and return to Ahab Wheathoof.

objectivesText.1: Escape the Furbolg cave and meet Terenthis in Auberdine.
Bring the package of Rare Earth to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
